blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Consumer group National Association of Electricity Consumers for Reforms (Nasecore) urged the Department of Energy (DOE) to disclose revised bidding rules for the next Semirara coal operating contract and require enforceable commitments on domestic supply, pricing, and uninterrupted production. In a statement, Nasecore said the bidding should allow fair competition and deliver measurable benefits to electricity consumers.The group cited the DOE’s termination of the 2026 coal bid round in September to reassess the award parameters. READ: Semirara cries foul over ‘unfair’ coal bidding rules Furthermore, Nasecore warned that qualification requirements tailored too closely to the incumbent’s operating history […]...
